title: Junior Ski Rental Package for Salt Lake City - Cottonwood Resorts
includes: Park City or Deer Valley shop pick-up (not included)
Damage insurance: $2 - $4 based on item (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Junior skiers must have a shoe size 6 and under, under 5' tall, and less than 100 lbs, to be accommodated with this package regardless of age
policies: You are permitted to pick up your skis the night before you ski after 4pm, so you can enjoy a full day on the slopes. You have until 10:00 am the day after your final ski day to return the gear.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This Junior Ski Package is perfect for young skiers of all abilities. The rental period is 24 hours, leaving you plenty of time to enjoy making turns. Juniors must be size 6 shoe and under, under 100 lbs, and less than 5' tall, regardless of age
